raw_segments.text: Secondly, I answer, such revolutions happen not upon every little mismanagement in public
Great mistakes in the ruling part, many wrong and inconvenient laws, and all the slips of
human frailty, will be borne by the people without mutiny or murmur.
But if a long train of abuses, pre-verications and artifices, all tending the same way, make
the design visible to the people, and they cannot but feel what they lie under and see
It is not to be wondered that they should then ruse themselves and endeavour to put
the rule into such hands which may secure to them the ends for which government was
And without which, ancient names and specious forms are so far from being better that they
are much worse than the state of nature or pure anarchy, the inconveniences being all
as great and as near, but the remedy farther off and more difficult.
